record.title: Main-house steps and a partial railed approach
record.alt: The side of a white two-story house has stone steps beneath a small covered doorway; gravel and grass surround it, and part of a dark-railed porch approach is visible at the right behind a white picket fence.
record.caption: A March 4, 2023 view shows steps beside the main house, nearby gravel, and part of a railed approach on the right. The whole approach and its doorway are outside this view. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.

record.limitations: Historical photograph, not a current route inspection. It does not establish the ramp gradient, width, landing, door threshold, complete parking-to-door connection or availability of the first-floor entrance. Confirm the rear ramp and current assistance arrangements with Dinsmore.
